an6.60:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā bārāṇasiyaṃ viharati isipatane migadāye.
an6.60:1.3: tena kho pana samayena sambahulā therā bhikkhū pacchābhattaṃ piṇḍapātapaṭikkantā maṇḍalamāḷe sannisinnā sannipatitā abhidhammakathaṃ kathenti.
an6.60:1.4: tatra sudaṃ āyasmā citto hatthisāriputto therānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ abhidhammakathaṃ kathentānaṃ antarantarā kathaṃ opāteti.
an6.60:1.5: atha kho āyasmā mahākoṭṭhiko āyasmantaṃ cittaṃ hatthisāriputataṃ etadavoca
an6.60:1.6: āyasmā citto hatthisāriputto therānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ abhidhammakathaṃ kathentānaṃ antarantarā kathaṃ opāteti yāva kathāpariyosānaṃ āyasmā citto hatthisāriputto āgametūti.
an6.60:1.7: evaṃ vutte āyasmato cittassa hatthisāriputtassa sahāyakā bhikkhū āyasmantaṃ mahākoṭṭhikaṃ etadavocuṃ
an6.60:1.8: āyasmā mahākaṭṭhikopi āyasmantaṃ cittaṃ hatthisāriputtaṃ apasādeti paṇḍito āyasmā citto hatthisārīputto
an6.60:1.9: pahoti āyasmā citto hatthisāriputto therānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ abhidhammakathaṃ kathetunti.
an6.60:2.1: dujjānaṃ kho etaṃ āvuso parassa cetopariyāyaṃ ajānantehi.
an6.60:2.2: idhāvuso ekacco puggalo tāvadeva soratasorato hoti nivātanivāto hoti upasantupasanto hoti yāva satthāraṃ upanissāya viharati aññataraṃ vā garuṭṭhāniyaṃ sabrahmacāriṃ
an6.60:2.3: yato ca kho so vapakassateva satthārā vapakassati garuṭṭhāniyehi sabrahmacārīhi so saṃsaṭṭho viharati bhikkhūhi bhikkhunīhi upāsakehi upāsikāhi raññā rājamahāmattehi titthiyehi titthiyasāvakehi
an6.60:2.4: tassa saṃsaṭṭhassa vissaṭṭhassa pākaṭassa bhassamanuyuttassa viharato rāgo cittaṃ anuddhaṃseti
an6.60:2.5: so rāgānuddhaṃsitena cittena sikkhaṃ paccakkhāya hīnāyāvattati
an6.60:3.1: seyyathāpi āvuso goṇo kiṭṭhādo dāmena vā baddho vaje vā oruddho
an6.60:3.2: yo nu kho āvuso evaṃ vadeyya nadānāyaṃ goṇo kiṭṭhādo punadeva kiṭṭhaṃ otarissatīti sammā nu kho so āvuso vadamāno vadeyyāti
an6.60:3.4: ṭhānañhetaṃ āvuso vijjati yaṃ so goṇo kiṭṭhādo dāmaṃ vā chetvā vajaṃ vā bhinditvā atha punadeva kiṭṭhaṃ otareyyāti
an6.60:3.5: evameva kho āvuso idhekacco puggalo tāvadeva soratasorato hoti nivātanivāto hoti upasantupasanto hoti yāva satthāraṃ upanissāya viharati aññataraṃ vā garuṭṭhāniyaṃ sabrahmacāriṃ
an6.60:3.6: yato ca kho so vapakassateva satthārā vapakassati garuṭṭhāniyehi sabrahmacārīhi so saṃsaṭṭho viharati bhikkhūhi bhikkhunīhi upāsakehi upāsikāhi raññā rājamahāmattehi titthiyehi titthiyasāvakehi
an6.60:3.7: tassa saṃsaṭṭhassa vissaṭṭhassa pākaṭassa bhassamanuyuttassa viharato rāgo cittaṃ anuddhaṃseti
an6.60:3.8: so rāgānuddhaṃsitena cittena sikkhaṃ paccakkhāya hīnāyāvattati.
an6.60:4.1: idha panāvuso ekacco puggalo vivicceva kāmehi …pe… paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati
an6.60:4.2: so lābhimhi paṭhamassa jhānassāti saṃsaṭṭho viharati bhikkhūhi …pe…
an6.60:4.4: seyyathāpi āvuso cātummahāpathe thullaphusitako devo vassanto rajaṃ antaradhāpeyya cikkhallaṃ pātukareyya
an6.60:4.5: yo nu kho āvuso evaṃ vadeyya nadāni amusmiṃ cātummahāpathe punadeva rajo pātubhavissatīti sammā nu kho so āvuso vadamāno vadeyyāti
an6.60:4.7: ṭhānañhetaṃ āvuso vijjati yaṃ amusmiṃ cātummahāpathe manussā vā atikkameyyuṃ gopasū vā atikkameyyuṃ vātātapo vā snehagataṃ pariyādideyya atha punadeva rajo pātubhaveyyāti
an6.60:4.8: evameva kho āvuso idhekacco puggalo vivicceva kāmehi …pe… paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati
an6.60:4.9: so lābhimhi paṭhamassa jhānassāti saṃsaṭṭho viharati bhikkhūhi …pe…
an6.60:5.1: idha panāvuso ekacco puggalo vitakkavicārānaṃ vūpasamā …pe… dutiyaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati
an6.60:5.2: so lābhimhi dutiyassa jhānassāti saṃsaṭṭho viharati bhikkhūhi …pe…
an6.60:5.4: seyya thāpi āvuso gāmassa vā nigamassa vā avidūre mahantaṃ taḷākaṃ
an6.60:5.5: tattha thullaphusitako devo vuṭṭho sippisambukampi sakkharakathalampi antaradhāpeyya
an6.60:5.6: yo nu kho āvuso evaṃ vadeyya nadāni amusmiṃ taḷāke punadeva sippisambukā vā sakkharakathalā vā pātubhavissantīti sammā nu kho so āvuso vadamāno vadeyyāti
an6.60:5.8: ṭhānañhetaṃ āvuso vijjati yaṃ amusmiṃ taḷāke manussā vā piveyyuṃ gopasū vā piveyyuṃ vātātapo vā snehagataṃ pariyādiyeyya atha punadeva sippisambukāpi sakkharakathalāpi pātubhaveyyunti
an6.60:5.9: evameva kho āvuso idhekacco puggalo vitakkavicārānaṃ vūpasamā …pe… dutiyaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati
an6.60:5.10: so lābhimhi dutiyassa jhānassāti saṃsaṭṭho viharati bhikkhūhi …pe…
an6.60:6.1: idha panāvuso ekacco puggalo pītiyā ca virāgā …pe… tatiyaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati
an6.60:6.2: so lābhimhi tatiyassa jhānassāti saṃsaṭṭho viharati bhikkhūhi …pe…
an6.60:6.4: seyyathāpi āvuso purisaṃ paṇītabhojanaṃ bhuttāviṃ abhidosikaṃ bhojanaṃ nacchādeyya
an6.60:6.5: yo nu kho āvuso evaṃ vadeyya nadāni amuṃ purisaṃ punadeva bhojanaṃ chādessatīti sammā nu kho so āvuso vadamāno vadeyyāti
an6.60:6.7: amuñhāvuso purisaṃ paṇītabhojanaṃ bhuttāviṃ yāvassa sā ojā kāye ṭhassati tāva na aññaṃ bhojanaṃ chādessati
an6.60:6.8: yato ca khvassa sā ojā antaradhāyissati atha punadeva taṃ bhojanaṃ chādeyyāti
an6.60:6.9: evameva kho āvuso idhekacco puggalo pītiyā ca virāgā …pe… tatiyaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati
an6.60:6.10: so lābhimhi tatiyassa jhānassāti saṃsaṭṭho viharati bhikkhūhi …pe…
an6.60:7.1: idha panāvuso ekacco puggalo sukhassa ca pahānā dukkhassa ca pahānā …pe… catutthaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati
an6.60:7.2: so lābhimhi catutthassa jhānassāti saṃsaṭṭho viharati bhikkhūhi …pe…
an6.60:7.4: seyyathāpi āvuso pabbatasaṃkhepe udakarahado nivāto vigataūmiko
an6.60:7.5: yo nu kho āvuso evaṃ vadeyya nadāni amusmiṃ udakarahade punadeva ūmi pātubhavissatīti sammā nu kho so āvuso vadamāno vadeyyāti
an6.60:7.7: ṭhānañhetaṃ āvuso vijjati yā puratthimāya disāya āgaccheyya bhūsā vātavuṭṭhi sā tasmiṃ udakarahade ūmiṃ janeyya yā pacchimāya disāya āgaccheyya …pe… uttarāya disāya āgaccheyya dakkhiṇāya disāya āgaccheyya bhūsā vātavuṭṭhi sā tasmiṃ udakarahade ūmiṃ janeyyāti
an6.60:7.8: evameva kho āvuso idhekacco puggalo sukhassa ca pahānā dukkhassa ca pahānā …pe… catutthaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati
an6.60:7.9: so lābhimhi catutthassa jhānassāti saṃsaṭṭho viharati bhikkhūhi …pe…
an6.60:8.1: idha panāvuso ekacco puggalo sabbanimittānaṃ amanasikārā animittaṃ cetosamādhiṃ upasampajja viharati
an6.60:8.2: so lābhimhi animittassa cetosamādhissāti saṃsaṭṭho viharati bhikkhūhi bhikkhunīhi upāupāsakehi upāsikāhi raññā rājamahāmattehi titthiyehi titthiyasāvakehi
an6.60:8.3: tassa saṃsaṭṭhassa vissaṭṭhassa pākaṭassa bhassamanuyuttassa viharato rāgo cittaṃ anuddhaṃseti
an6.60:8.4: so rāgānuddhaṃsitena cittena sikkhaṃ paccakkhāya hīnāyāvattati
an6.60:8.5: seyyathāpi āvuso rājā vā rājamahāmatto vā caturaṅginiyā senāya addhānamaggapaṭipanno aññatarasmiṃ vanasaṇḍe ekarattiṃ vāsaṃ upagaccheyya
an6.60:8.6: tatra hatthisaddena assasaddena rathasaddena pattisaddena bheripaṇavasaṅkhavīṇāninnādasaddena cīriḷikāsaddo antaradhāpeyya
an6.60:8.7: yo nu kho evaṃ vadeyya nadāni amusmiṃ vanasaṇḍe punadeva cīriḷikāsaddo pātubhavissatīti sammā nu kho so āvuso vadamāno vadeyyāti
an6.60:8.9: ṭhānañhetaṃ āvuso vijjati yaṃ so rājā vā rājamahāmatto vā tamhā vanasaṇḍā pakkameyya atha punadeva cīriḷikāsaddo pātubhaveyyāti
an6.60:8.10: evameva kho āvuso idhekacco puggalo sabbanimittānaṃ amanasikārā animittaṃ cetosamādhiṃ upasampajja viharati
an6.60:8.11: so lābhimhi animittassa cetosamādhissāti saṃsaṭṭho viharati bhikkhūhi bhikkhunīhi upāsakehi upāsikāhi raññā rājamahāmattehi titthiyehi titthiyasāvakehi
an6.60:8.12: tassa saṃsaṭṭhassa vissaṭṭhassa pākaṭassa bhassamanuyuttassa viharato rāgo cittaṃ anuddhaṃseti
an6.60:8.13: so rāgānuddhaṃsitena cittena sikkhaṃ paccakkhāya hīnāyāvattatīti.
an6.60:9.1: athakho āyasmā citto hatthisāriputto aparena samayena sikkhaṃ paccakkhāya hīnāyāvattati.
an6.60:9.2: atha kho cittassa hatthisāriputtassa sahāyakā bhikkhū yenāyasmā mahākoṭṭhiko tenupasaṅkamiṃsu upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantaṃ mahākoṭṭhikaṃ etadavocuṃ
an6.60:9.3: kiṃ nu kho āyasmatā mahākoṭṭhikena citto hatthisāriputto cetasā ceto paricca vidito
an6.60:9.4: imāsañca imāsañca vihārasamāpattīnaṃ citto hatthisāriputto lābhī atha ca pana sikkhaṃ paccakkhāya hīnāyāvattissatīti
an6.60:9.6: citto bhante hatthisāriputto imāsañca imāsañca vihārasamāpattīnaṃ lābhī atha ca pana sikkhaṃ paccakkhāya hīnāyāvattissatīti.
an6.60:9.7: cetaso ceto paricca vidito me āvuso
an6.60:9.8: citto hatthisārīputto imāsañca imāsañca vihārasamāpattīnaṃ lābhī atha ca pana sikkhaṃ paccakkhāya hīnāyāvattissatīti
an6.60:9.10: citto bhante hatthisāriputto imāsañca imāsañca vihārasamāpattīnaṃ lābhī atha ca pana sikkhaṃ paccakkhāya hīnāyāvattissatīti
an6.60:10.1: atha kho cittassa hatthisāriputtassa sahāyakā bhikkhū yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkamiṃsu upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃsu ekamantaṃ nisinnā kho te bhikkhū bhagavantaṃ etadavocuṃ
an6.60:10.2: citto bhante hatthisāriputto imāsañca imāsañca vihārasamāpattīnaṃ lābhī atha ca pana sikkhaṃ paccakkhāya hīnāyāvattoti
an6.60:10.3: na bhikkhave citto ciraṃ sarissati nekkhammassāti.
an6.60:11.1: athakho citto hatthisāriputto na cirasseva kesamassuṃ ohāretvā kāsāyāni vatthāni acchādetvā agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbaji.
an6.60:11.2: atha kho āyasmā citto hatthisāriputto ekako vūpakaṭṭho appamatto ātāpī pahitatto viharanto na cirasseva yassatthāya kulaputtā sammadeva agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajanti tadanuttaraṃ brahmacariyapariyosānaṃ diṭṭheva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja vihāsi
an6.60:11.3: khīṇā jāti vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ nāparaṃ itthattāyāti abbhaññāsi
an6.60:11.4: aññataro ca panāyasmā citto hatthisāriputto arahataṃ ahosīti. 61
